headline: Career Dashboard, from entry to detail
overview: A unified view of your career health across all assessments. See your strengths, personality fit, values alignment, and growth areas synthesized into a single actionable career snapshot.
targetAudience: Users interested in career tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Career Dashboard — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the unified career health overview with assessment summaries, strengths, and key insights.
steps.screenshotAlt: Career Dashboard landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Unified view of career health synthesizing all career-related assessments
Snapshot of strengths, personality fit, and values alignment
Identify growth areas and career development opportunities
Actionable next steps based on your career profile
tips: Complete more career assessments to enrich your dashboard — the more data, the more personalized your career insights.
Review your dashboard quarterly to track how your career profile and priorities evolve over time.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
